title: Huge extinct orca may have eaten other whales | New Scientist
description: A nearly 8-metre-long species of orca lived in the North Sea over 2 million years ago. Its discovery suggests orcas evolved a diet of marine mammals earlier than scientists thought
author: Jake Buehler

title: Woman entered hibernation-like state during winter for more than 30 years | New Scientist
description: Researchers studying brains donated for scientific research stumbled upon the remarkable case of a woman who went through prolonged periods of reduced activity in which her body temperature dropped to as low as 31°C
author: Carissa Wong

title: Cooking pollution dominates air quality at mealtimes in London | New Scientist
description: Particulate matter from kitchens is the largest source of air pollution during lunch and dinner in the city of London, an analysis shows
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Turmeric supplements offer little benefit for knee osteoarthritis | New Scientist
description: A comprehensive review of clinical trials indicates that turmeric supplements had no meaningful effect on quality of life for people with knee osteoarthritis
author: Carissa Wong

title: New Scientist is 70 years old – join us in celebrating | New Scientist
description: From a look back at the past 70 years of scientific discovery to a flash forward to the end of the century, we have a host of celebrations for our 70th anniversary
author: Sam Wong

title: The real reasons we keep seeing big tech outages – it isn't just hackers | New Scientist
description: In a single week, banks, an air traffic control system, millions of email accounts and spy agency systems have suffered outages. But speculation about an AI hacking spree or a coordinated attack by a foreign power are wide of the mark
author: Matthew Sparkes
